description: Derivative of x raised to a constant power

description: Derivative of a product of two functions

name: Quotient Rule
description: Derivative of a quotient of two functions

name: Chain Rule
description: Derivative of a composition of functions

description: Differentiation undoes integration

description: Evaluate a definite integral using an antiderivative F

description: Technique for integrating products of functions

name: Taylor Series
description: Infinite series expansion of a function about a point a

description: Taylor series of e^x centered at 0

name: L'Hopital's Rule

name: Substitution Rule
description: Change of variable technique for integration

description: Sum of an infinite geometric series with common ratio r

description: Derivative of an exponential function via chain rule

name: Derivative of Natural Log
description: Derivative of the natural logarithm

expression: \det \begin{pmatrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{pmatrix} = ad - bc

description: Inverse of a 2x2 matrix when det(A) is nonzero

name: Dot Product
description: Inner product of two vectors and its geometric interpretation

expression: \vec{u} \times \vec{v} = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ u_1 & u_2 & u_3 \\ v_1 & v_2 & v_3 \end{vmatrix}

description: Definition of eigenvalue lambda and eigenvector v of matrix A

name: Characteristic Polynomial
description: Equation whose roots are the eigenvalues of A

description: Sum of diagonal entries, equals the sum of eigenvalues

description: Dimension of column space plus dimension of null space equals number of columns

name: Orthogonal Projection
description: Projection of vector v onto vector u

name: Gram-Schmidt Process
description: Orthogonalization of a set of vectors

name: Cayley-Hamilton Theorem

name: Euler Characteristic
description: Topological invariant relating vertices, edges, and faces of a polyhedron

description: Euler characteristic of an orientable surface of genus g

name: Fundamental Group of Circle

expression: f: D^n \to D^n \Rightarrow \exists\, x : f(x) = x

description: The fundamental group of the torus is Z x Z

description: Homotopy equivalent spaces share the same Euler characteristic

name: Euler's Totient Function

name: Fermat's Little Theorem
description: For prime p and any integer a

description: Generalization of Fermat's little theorem to any modulus

name: Quadratic Reciprocity
description: Relates the Legendre symbols of two odd primes p and q

name: Chinese Remainder Theorem
description: System of congruences with coprime moduli has a unique solution

name: Prime Number Theorem
description: The number of primes up to x is asymptotically x/ln(x)

name: Wilson's Theorem
description: A number p is prime if and only if (p-1)! is congruent to -1 mod p

name: Mobius Inversion Formula
description: Recovers f from its Dirichlet convolution with the constant function

name: Bayes' Theorem
description: Updates probability of A given evidence B

name: Law of Total Probability
description: Total probability from a partition of the sample space

name: Expected Value
description: Weighted average of all possible values of a random variable

name: Variance
description: Measure of spread of a distribution

name: Binomial Distribution
description: Probability of k successes in n independent Bernoulli trials

name: Normal Distribution PDF
description: Probability density function of the Gaussian distribution

name: Poisson Distribution
description: Probability of k events in a fixed interval with average rate lambda

name: Law of Large Numbers
description: Sample mean converges in probability to the population mean

name: Central Limit Theorem
description: Standardized sample mean converges in distribution to a standard normal

name: Lagrange's Theorem
description: The order of a subgroup divides the order of the group

name: First Isomorphism Theorem
description: A homomorphism induces an isomorphism between G/ker and the image

description: Curvature of a curve y=f(x) in the plane

name: Gauss-Bonnet Theorem
description: Relates total Gaussian curvature to the Euler characteristic

name: Frenet-Serret Formulas
expression: \begin{pmatrix} T' \\ N' \\ B' \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} 0 & \kappa & 0 \\ -\kappa & 0 & \tau \\ 0 & -\tau & 0 \end{pmatrix} \begin{pmatrix} T \\ N \\ B \end{pmatrix}

name: Gaussian Curvature
description: Product of principal curvatures at a point on a surface

name: First Fundamental Form
description: Metric on a parametrized surface measuring lengths and angles

name: Geodesic Equation
description: Equation of motion for the shortest path on a curved surface

name: Theorema Egregium
expression: K = K(E, F, G, \text{and their derivatives})
description: Gaussian curvature depends only on the first fundamental form (intrinsic geometry)

description: The power set of a set with n elements has 2^n elements

name: Cantor's Theorem
description: No set can be put in bijection with its power set

name: Inclusion-Exclusion (Two Sets)

name: Cartesian Product Cardinality

name: Schroder-Bernstein Theorem

expression: ar^2 + br + c = 0 \quad \text{for } ay'' + by' + cy = 0

description: Particular solution using the Wronskian W of two homogeneous solutions

description: Number of ways to choose k items from n without regard to order

description: Asymptotic approximation for factorials

name: Catalan Numbers
description: Counts balanced parenthesizations, full binary trees, and many other structures

name: Stars and Bars
description: Number of ways to place n indistinguishable balls into k distinguishable bins

name: Derangements
description: Number of permutations with no fixed points

name: Multinomial Coefficient
description: Number of ways to partition n objects into groups of given sizes

expression: n > k \Rightarrow \exists \text{ box with } \geq \lceil n/k \rceil \text{ items}

name: Euler's Identity
description: Relates five fundamental constants: e, i, pi, 1, and 0

name: Convolution (Laplace)
description: Laplace transform of a convolution is the product of transforms

name: Generating Function (Fibonacci)

name: Residue Theorem
